faq.q: What does Commercial Carpet Care — Core Methods cover?
faq.a: Practical commercial carpet maintenance aligned with professional cleaning expectations in education, retail, and strata settings.

faq.q: Which syllabus topics are listed for Commercial Carpet Care — Core Methods?
faq.a: Syllabus topics include Module 1 — Fibre ID & construction; Module 2 — Soil types & traffic patterns; Module 3 — Pre-inspection & testing; Module 4 — Dry soil removal; Module 5 — Hot water extraction methods; Module 6 — Low-moisture & interim systems.
